caseNameFull: Mu'Min v. Murray, Director, Virginia Department of Corrections Nethery v. Collins, Director, Texas Department of Criminal Justice, Institutional Division Comer v. Arizona Davis v. Arkansas

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Va.;

C. A. 5th Cir.;

Super. Ct. Ariz., Maricopa County; and

Sup. Ct. Ark. Certiorari denied.

opinions.author: Blackmun
opinions.text:
Justice Blackmun,

dissenting.

Adhering to my view that the death penalty cannot be imposed fairly within the constraints of our Constitution, see my dissent in Callins v. Collins, 510 U. S. 1141, 1143 (1994), I would grant certiorari and vacate the death sentences in these cases.
